description: List the characters in the asset library this key reaches: named sets of images, each image an asset with its own uri. Newest first, one page at a time; pass nextCursor back as cursor to continue. Pass assetId to find the characters that contain one asset. To use a character, put the uri (spicy://a/<id>) of its images, in the order given, into the reference image field of the model's input (spicyapi_model_get shows which field), and refer to them in the prompt the way that model's page describes. Characters are created and edited on the web; these tools only read them. Older spicy://p/<id> persona references still resolve to the same images, in the personal library only.

assetId.description: Only the characters that contain this asset (ast_… or spicy://a/<id>).

name: spicyapi_characters_list

assets.description: The character's images in order. Put their uri values, in this order, into the model's reference image field.

favorite.description: Favorite mark of the library; in a team library everyone sees the same ones.

model.description: Public name of the model that generated the asset; empty for uploads and links.

modelName.description: Display name of that model; may be empty.

previewUrl.description: Private preview signed for at most 20 minutes; empty when signing failed. Never store or share it; keep uri instead.

uri.description: Stable spicy://a/<id> reference. Put it in any media field of a model input; it works until the asset is deleted and only in requests made with keys of the same workspace.
